snippet.title: Trident's Tale - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Trident’s Tale is out now! 🏴‍☠️⚓
Join Ocean on a magical pirate adventure across vibrant islands, thrilling naval combat, and a massive open world to explore. Recruit your crew, uncover hidden treasures, and become a legend of the seas!
Available now on PC, @NintendoAmerica  Switch, @XBOX  Series X|S, and @PlayStation  4/5.  PC version available on @Steam  and @EpicGamesStore
